subject: planner: Add variable for no_decorrelate in select list (#63204)
summary: Reviewed this commit (vs parent) in `pkg/planner/core` and `pkg/sessionctx/*`. It adds sysvar `tidb_opt_enable_no_decorrelate_in_select` (default OFF) and uses it to (a) auto-enable `NO_DECORRELATE` for correlated scalar/EXISTS subqueries in the SELECT field list (via clause tracking frozen into the expression rewriter plan context) and (b) skip correlated-aggregate extraction when the variable is enabled. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/session-behavior issues found in the touched planner/sessionctx paths.
